g.text: Institutional Financial Pipeline with Orchestrated Data Freshness & Peer-Review
• SEC 8-K: Strip HTML, Markdown, chunk by Item
Pre-compiled daily global background on Fed rates, GPR, etc.
Bypasses retrieval entirely. Acts as the baseline environment
that grounds the AI's understanding of the current market.
• Enforces ticker allowlists & prevents database explosion limits.
• Two-stage transformation isolates query target concepts.
• Dense Model gets a generated HyDE paragraph (captures concept).
• Sparse Model gets a strict 8-15 word exact query (prevents dilution).
• Fuses scores based on rank position.
• Catches logic nuances (e.g., Vest vs Sell).
Drafts strategy from merged context with citation discipline.
Verifies numeric consistency & citation anchor validity.
Stress-tests risk posture, logical contradictions & regime mismatches.
• Deterministic gate logic to prevent infinite loops
Emits schema-constrained final report for downstream consumers.
Consumes node-level stream events & renders progressive UI.
Writes frontend trace, final_state, and summary bundle artifacts.
Provides run-scoped backend audit logs for deterministic node replay.
